# 06 — ISO 42001 / Learning-Log Overlap

contributions, disclosures, or audit trails?

## ISO 42001 Mapping

| ISO 42001 Clause / Theme | External Practice | NeatapticTS Practice                         |
| ------------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| Organizational roles     | `...`             | Tier-1..3 agents + orchestrators             |
| AI system lifecycle      | `...`             | Phase 0..G + plan trackers                   |
| Documented information   | `...`             | `plans/`, `learning-log.jsonl`               |
| Impact assessment        | `...`             | Risk coordinators + gate contracts           |
| Monitoring / measurement | `...`             | `coverage-guard`, `quality:folder`, gate MCP |
| Competence / training    | `...`             | Skills + educational-docs                    |
